course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice paraphrasing when the exact Swedish word is missing.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A digital service problem must be explained even though one technical term is forgotten.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Describing a missing word through function, appearance, or result.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik try to explain a problem with a login or online form and paraphrase the missing term instead of switching to English.

main_focus.name: paraphrasing with det som, något som, and när man
main_focus.description: Use simple relative and explanatory frames to describe an unknown or forgotten word.
model_examples: Det är något som man använder för att logga in.
Jag menar den sidan där man fyller i personnumret.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use paraphrasing frames naturally 3-5 times when the exact word is missing or delayed.

avoid_grammar: advanced relative pronouns such as vars as a focus

vocabulary_target.theme: digital service problem and paraphrase strategies
useful_chunks: Det är det som man använder för att...
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical digital words but keep the main practice on paraphrasing and repair.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker cannot remember the exact word for part of a digital process.
dialogue_shape.middle: They paraphrase the problem, check whether the description is clear, and improve the wording.
dialogue_shape.ending: They settle on a clear Swedish explanation that could be used with support or a friend.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat paraphrase frames with different parts of the digital process

focus: how the missing word is paraphrased
the clearer final explanation of the problem

sentence_focus: one sentence with Jag kommer inte på ordet
one sentence with något som man använder för att
one sentence with sidan där man
one sentence explaining a login problem
one sentence checking whether the paraphrase is understandable
